Page 01 • For Your Eyes Only 🌷✨🧸

Dearest Bestie,

Happy, happy birthday to the person who makes ordinary days feel like my favorite memories! Every time I think about all the late-night talks, random laughs until our stomachs hurt, and quiet moments where we didn't even need words, I feel so lucky that life made us friends.

And thank you for being part of life and the memories we have created together. No matter the distance between us our bond would always stays the same. You are the first person that comes into my mind to share my highs and lows. I love you soo.. much...

No matter where life takes us or how busy things get, remember that I am always there for you. I hope this surprise makes your special day even more special.

Forever grateful for you,

Your Bestie. Love ya 💖
